2117418086139670696.en_summary: @MarkNewtonCMT says $AAPL is a bit wobbly near-term and momentum gave warnings for short-term oriented over the last month. However, larger trends remain quite robust with no meaningful deterioration, so near-term weakness likely proves short-lived this week. Tech has some work to do until Nov expiration, but broader market resilience and breadth with waning cross-asset volatility help the bigger picture. Elections aren't an all-clear, but by Nov 21-24 expects markets to act better broadly.
2117418086139670696.zh_summary: @MarkNewtonCMT 表示 $AAPL 短期有點不穩，過去一個月動能為短線交易者發出警告。然而，較大趨勢仍然相當穩健，沒有明顯惡化，因此本週的短期弱勢可能短暫。科技股在 11 月到期前有些工作要做，但更廣泛市場的韌性與廣度以及跨資產波動率下降有助於大局。選舉不是全面放行，但預計到 11 月 21-24 日市場將以更廣泛方式表現更好。
